changelog:
- Initial release of the weekly-report-writer skill.
- Enables automatic generation of clear, structured Chinese weekly reports when triggered by keywords related to work summaries or progress reporting.
- Follows a consistent template focusing on completed work, quantifiable results, risks/issues, and next week’s plans.
- Prioritizes concise, result-oriented statements using “action + result + impact” format.
- Clearly marks incomplete information with placeholders for further input.
summary: 用于撰写结构清晰的中文周报。只要用户提到“周报、weekly report、本周总结、工作复盘、下周计划、给老板汇报”，即使没有明确说“写周报”，也应主动使用此技能来生成可直接发送的周报内容。
